description: Empirical ASF chain-growth-probability (alpha) curve vs reactor temperature (np.interp; high alpha at low LTFT temperatures) and CO-conversion curve. Diesel-cut selectivity derived from alpha via the Anderson-Schulz-Flory distribution. Numbers reused from EC150 F1b.
source: Dry (2002) Catalysis Today; van der Laan & Beenackers (1999) — reused from EC150 F1b

alpha_ref.note: ASF chain-growth probability at design (high diesel+wax)

alpha_curve.comment: Chain-growth probability alpha vs temperature (degC). Higher T -> lower alpha (lighter products), per Dry (2002).

co_conversion_curve.comment: CO conversion vs temperature (degC); rises with T but levels off / methane penalty at high T.

diesel_carbon_range.note: ASF mass fraction in the C10-C20 diesel cut
